title: About 3.6% of people lived outside their country of origin in 2020
body: The UN estimated 281 million international migrants in 2020, up from 173 million in 2000. As the world population also grew, the migrant share rose from 2.8% to 3.6%.
takeaway: A headcount and a share tell different stories about the scale of migration.
